subject: Critical: employee separation & stabilization plan - Acme Health coverage
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Immediate separation: [REDACTED] — stabilization & access

Team,

I need to flag an involuntary separation for a member of Eng (name withheld for confidentiality) that will be effective 2026-11-06 at 17:00 PT. The situation is sensitive and we've agreed with Legal to proceed immediately. High-level asks below — please treat as confidential.

1) HR (Monica) — please prepare a standard separation packet and Docusign flow. We will offer the attached separation template and a short severance package; please draft the final language and confirm whether we need exec sign-off.

2) Security (Markus) — schedule access revocation to occur at 17:00 PT on 11/06. We need VPN/SSO off, GCP/Prod keys rotated, and a snapshot of any active long-running jobs. I will provide laptop serials and a list of corporate accounts the user owns.

3) Finance (Naomi) — can you estimate final pay (prorated salary + accrued PTO) and confirm payroll cutoff for benefit continuation? If this hits cutoff, please advise timing for the final deposit.

4) Lauren — we need coverage for the Acme Health integration (AM widget). I'll loop Amanda Reed and J. Singh on a brief transition note; please coordinate a hotfix handoff tomorrow morning.

I've attached an offboarding checklist and the initial separation template for review. I'll be available on a call at 11:30 if anyone needs to talk through the timing.

This needs to remain on a need-to-know basis until DocuSign is sent.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director of Engineering, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com

Attachments: offboarding-checklist.xlsx, SeparationAgreement_ACME_1106.pdf

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate separation: [REDACTED] — stabilization & access

Irene,

Acknowledged — thank you for the heads up. I will prepare the separation packet and DocuSign envelope. Two quick asks so we can move immediately:

- Please confirm the employee's legal full name and the preferred last working day (you indicated 11/06 at 17:00 PT).
- Send a manager-provided list of all internal/external accounts to transfer or disable (GitHub, GCP projects, PagerDuty, Slack, Acme Health access).
- Confirm whether the employee will be offered outplacement or a reference letter.

I'll draft the separation agreement using the attached template and mark it as urgent. I can also join your 11:30 PT call.

Best,
Monica
Monica Patel
Senior HR Business Partner
monica.patel@redwood.com

Attachment: InitialSeparationTemplate.docx

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate separation: [REDACTED] — security prep

Irene/Monica,

We will enact the standard access revocation playbook at 17:00 PT on 11/06. Plan:
- Disable SSO and VPN (immediate at cutoff)
- Rotate Prod service account keys that the user had access to
- Revoke GCP console and IAM roles
- Snapshot any running compute jobs and capture logs for legal if needed

Requests from our side: please provide laptop serial and any personal token creds that need clearing (e.g., personal deploy keys in repos). If the user has scheduled cron jobs or long-running notebooks in Prod, we need to know owners so we can reassign or terminate gracefully.

I'll coordinate with IT to collect the device and with QA to pause any in-flight deploys owned by the individual.

Attachment: access-revocation-playbook.pdf
-Markus

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate separation: payroll ask

Irene/Monica,

We can produce a final pay estimate by EOD today given the termination date/time. Items we'll include:
- Prorated salary through 11/06 17:00 PT
- Accrued PTO payout (per policy)
- Any bonus/commission accruals (confirm eligibility)

Please confirm the termination reason code (we need this for benefits administration) and that expense reports are approved. Payroll cutoff for the 11/12 run is 11/07 18:00 PT; if paperwork and timesheets are approved before then we can include the final deposit on 11/12. Otherwise it'll fall to the next cycle.

Attachment: final-pay-estimate.xlsx
Thanks,
Naomi
Payroll Lead, Finance
naomi.feldman@redwood.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-06T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate separation: employee details & device list

Monica/Markus/Naomi — details below.

Employee: [REDACTED] (legal name provided to Monica offline)
Manager: Irene Choi
Last day/time: 2026-11-06 17:00 PT
Devices: MacBook Pro SN: C02X1234JH7L, iPhone corporate IMEI: 356789012345678
Owned accounts to reassign: project-acme-integration (GCP), acme-api-key (rot), repo: acme-integration-service, PagerDuty: irene-oncall->lauren-oncall
Customer POC: Amanda Reed <amanda.reed@acmehealth.io> (I'll send a short transition note to Amanda and J. Singh to avoid surprise).

Termination reason code: "policy_violation_confidential" (shared with Legal). Expense reports: none outstanding.

Please proceed with DocuSign and access revocation per Markus' plan. I'll confirm handoff steps with Lauren at 09:30 PT.

--
Irene

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Immediate separation: confirmation & next steps

All — final confirmation: DocuSign envelope sent (link below) with the separation agreement and COBRA/benefits information. Access revocation is scheduled for 17:00 PT today; Security and IT will coordinate the disk collection window and hardware return. Finance confirms the final-pay estimate and will include the employee in the 11/12 payroll run.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/abcdef123456
Jira HR case: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HR-4211

Monica will own the outreach to the employee on next steps and the manager-facing template for a concise customer-facing transition note. Markus — please confirm when access revocation is completed so I can close the case.

Thanks,
Monica
Senior HR Business Partner
monica.patel@redwood.com
